Physics-Informed Deep Orthogonal Decomposition with Calibrated Uncertainty Quantification for Reduced-Order Modelling of Parametrized Partial Differential Equations

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Direct Read now numerical_benchmark UQ
Umar Daraz, Sehrish Maryam, Khaleel Ahmad International Scientific Spectrum 2026-09-06 10.66972/iscis202618
相关性: 该论文提出物理信息深度正交分解代理模型并带校准不确定性量化，直接对应FEA代理建模中的采样效率与UQ需求。
边界: The paper contains no implant or biomechanics application, no femoral stem stress-shielding or bone-implant interface validation, and no contact mechanics; it is a general parametrized PDE surrogate.
动机· 参数化PDE反复求解是设计、控制与数字孪生的效率瓶颈。
方法· 用离散方程残差在无标签配点上监督自适应基与约简系数，并耦合异方差与深度集成不确定性。
结果· 线性解码器可精确传递不确定性，并给出无求解器信任指标与分布无关覆盖保证。
验证· 在参数化PDE基准上进行数值验证，未涉及生物力学或植入物场景。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Repeatedly solving parametrized PDEs remains the computational bottleneck in design, control, inversion, and digital-twin workflows.
Method· The authors supervise a continuously adaptive basis and reduced coefficients with the discrete equation residual at unlabelled collocation parameters, and couple heteroscedastic aleatoric and deep-ensemble epistemic uncertainty estimates.
Result· The linear decoder is proven to transport uncertainty to the physical field exactly without inflation, and a solver-free trust indicator fuses predictive variance, equation residual, and Grassmann distance with coverage guarantees.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks on parametrized PDEs demonstrate the surrogate and uncertainty calibration, without biomedical or implant-specific cases.

Neutralizing excess stem anteversion during femoral preparation improves initial stability of a triple-tapered stem: a cadaveric biomechanical analysis

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Direct Read now cadaveric Exp. validation
Zachary Wells, Josué G. Layuno-Matos, Victor Shen, Miguel A. Diaz, Péter Simon et al. BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders 2026-09-09 10.1186/s12891-026-10342-w
单位: Florida Orthopaedic Institute (FOI), 13020 Telecom Pkwy N, Tampa, FL, 33637, USA
通讯: Brian T. Palumbo @ Florida Orthopaedic Institute (FOI), 13020 Telecom Pkwy N, Tampa, FL, 33637, USA
相关性: 该研究通过尸体力学实验量化了三锥度股骨柄的微动与初始稳定性，直接对应髋关节植入物与股骨柄方向的核心关注点。
边界: It does not perform finite element modeling, does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain or bone mineral density changes in Gruen zones, and does not compare intact versus implanted femur in a computational framework.
动机· 单锥度柄制备易导致三锥度柄过度前倾、尺寸偏小和松动，需改进技术。
方法· 18根尸体股骨分两组，分别用传统单锥度与实验三锥度制备，动态加载模拟下楼并采用DIC测量。
结果· 三锥度制备组存活率80%对20%，刚度更高、位移和微动更小，前倾角从7.6°降至2.7°。
验证· 尸体股骨动态循环加载结合数字图像相关测量。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Conventional single-taper preparation for triple-tapered stems often causes hyper-anteversion, undersizing, and loosening, motivating a preparation technique that aligns with the femoral mid-sagittal axis.
Method· Eighteen paired cadaveric femurs were allocated to conventional single-taper or experimental triple-taper preparation and subjected to cyclic stair-descent loading with digital image correlation to track displacement and micromotion.
Result· The triple-taper preparation group showed 80% survival to the final load step versus 20% for the conventional group, with significantly greater stiffness, less displacement and micromotion, and reduced stem anteversion from 7.6° to 2.7°.
Validation· Cadaveric biomechanical testing with dynamic cyclic loading and digital image correlation.

相关性: 该文提出变分物理信息图神经网络求解非均质固体力学，可迁移至植入物/骨-植入界面的FEA代理建模与参数化反演。
边界: No implant or bone-implant interface validation, no patient-specific geometry, and no contact mechanics; it is a general heterogeneous solid mechanics solver.
动机· 解决PINN在异质材料界面应力跳变处精度对正则化宽度和界面权重敏感的问题。
方法· 在自适应共形网格图上按单元赋本构，最小化离散总势能，仅含一阶导数且无惩罚项。
结果· 在刚度比跨越四个量级时von Mises误差低于3.58%，优于强形式PINN的5.58%。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Coordinate-based PINNs struggle with stress jumps at bimaterial interfaces because their accuracy depends on prescribed regularization widths or interface penalties.
Method· A variational, label-free physics-informed graph neural network minimizes the discrete total potential energy on a conforming adaptive mesh graph with per-element constitutive assignment and Dirichlet conditions enforced by construction.
Result· With a single fixed architecture and loss, the von Mises error stays below 3.58% across a stiffness-contrast sweep from 10^-2 to 10^2, outperforming a strong-form PINN at 5.58%.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks on small-strain elasticity and finite-strain Neo-Hookean hyperelasticity in two and three dimensions.

相关性: 该文提出混合代理模型与NSGA-II多目标优化框架，方法可迁移至植入体/生物力学结构的轻量化与多目标设计，但应用域为汽车座椅。
边界: No biomedical or implant context, no bone-implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification, and no patient-specific or biomechanical validation; it is automotive crashworthiness optimization.

Motivation· Highly nonlinear crash responses and ambiguous criterion weighting limit the reliability of single-surrogate multi-objective seat design.
Method· A high-fidelity finite element model is coupled with a hybrid surrogate, NSGA-II, and a modified preference selection index to obtain and rank Pareto-optimal designs.
Result· The optimized seat satisfies regulatory requirements while improving structural performance, demonstrating computational efficiency of the framework.
Validation· Rear-seat luggage impact, headrest static strength, and modal tests were performed on the optimized structure.

相关性: 该论文提出MATLAB-ABAQUS自动化参数化FEA与代理模型流程，方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计的仿真采样加速，但应用对象为阶梯圆轴而非髋关节植入物。
边界: It addresses stress concentration in stepped circular bars under axial loading, with no implant geometry, bone-implant interface, micromotion, or biomedical validation, and its surrogate is a simple regression/ML model without uncertainty quantification or constrained optimization.
动机· 阶梯圆轴肩部圆角处应力集中影响疲劳寿命，需高效预测应力集中系数。
方法· 用MATLAB生成全因子试验设计并驱动ABAQUS批量仿真，再建立回归与机器学习代理模型。
结果· 小径与圆角半径影响最大，代理模型R²约0.91，与Peterson图表误差5–8%。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Stress concentration at shoulder fillets of stepped circular bars governs fatigue life, motivating efficient prediction of stress concentration factors.
Method· A MATLAB-driven full factorial design of experiments automatically generates ABAQUS Python scripts for batch finite element simulations, and regression plus machine learning surrogate models map geometric parameters to stress concentration factors.
Result· Smaller diameter and fillet radius dominate the response, and the surrogate achieves an R-squared of about 0.91 with 5-8% agreement against Peterson charts.
Validation· Numerical predictions were benchmarked against classical Peterson stress concentration charts.

Motivation· Internal microdefects in LPBF components degrade structural integrity, necessitating high-precision non-destructive evaluation.

相关性: 该文提出工艺信息驱动的多尺度代理建模框架，将注塑纤维取向映射到结构有限元，方法可迁移到植入物/生物力学设计的仿真加速，但无生物医学验证。
边界: The paper addresses short-fiber composite lattice structures from compression molding with no implant mechanics, no bone-implant interface, no patient-specific geometry, and no uncertainty quantification, so it does not directly serve hip implant or biomedical FEA surrogate goals.
动机· 直接混配压缩成型短纤维复合材料点阵结构因纤维取向空间异质，非线性压缩行为难以预测。
方法· 结合Moldflow纤维取向预测、含界面粘聚的单胞模型与横观各向同性弹塑性代理模型，将区域化本构赋给杆件与四类节点进行精细有限元分析。
结果· 非线性阶段最大应力误差降至3.8%，优于均匀赋值的12.28%，减少逐区域力学表征需求。
验证· 以金相图像分析验证纤维取向预测（相对误差7.89%），并与均匀赋值策略对比验证结构应力预测。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Predicting the nonlinear compressive response of direct compounded compression molded short-fiber composite lattices is difficult because molding induces spatially heterogeneous fiber orientations.
Method· A process-informed multiscale framework combines Moldflow fiber orientation tensor prediction, a unit cell with fiber-matrix cohesive interface behavior, and a transversely isotropic elastoplastic surrogate with orientation averaging to assign region-specific properties to struts and four joint types in a refined finite element model.
Result· The framework reduces maximum stress error in the nonlinear stage to 3.8%, compared with 12.28% for the previous homogeneous assignment strategy, while avoiding exhaustive region-by-region mechanical characterization.
Validation· Fiber orientation predictions were validated against metallographic image analysis with 7.89% relative error, and structural stress predictions were benchmarked against a homogeneous assignment baseline.

边界: This paper addresses surface crystallography inverse problems rather than FEA surrogate modeling, and it contains no implant mechanics, no finite element validation, and no uncertainty quantification of surrogate predictions.
动机· 定量LEED-I(V)分析是复杂非凸反问题，传统方法依赖大量人工干预且采样效率低。
方法· 将多重散射前向模型与晶体对称性嵌入信赖域贝叶斯优化循环，同时优化结构与实验参数。
结果· 在Ag(100)和Fe2O3表面案例中，相同采样数下收敛更快、R因子低于随机游走、模拟退火和遗传算法。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Quantitative LEED-I(V) analysis remains a challenging non-convex inverse problem that traditionally demands extensive manual intervention and many forward evaluations.
Method· The authors embed multiple-scattering LEED forward models and crystallographic symmetry constraints into a trust-region Bayesian optimization loop that jointly optimizes structural and experimental parameters.

Motivation· Frozen design points are typically reported as single figures of merit, leaving their robustness under joint parameter uncertainty unquantified.
Method· Two independent 40,000-sample Monte-Carlo ensembles are propagated through reduced-order power- and particle-balance evaluators, with variance-based Sobol/ANOVA decomposition using Saltelli/Jansen estimators.
Result· Both design anchors lie well inside their achievable ensembles, and each machine's performance is dominated by a single uncertain input—confinement for the breeder and core pressure for the burner.
Validation· Numerical simulation case with GPU-accelerated Monte-Carlo sampling and explicit Monte-Carlo error analysis.

Motivation· Accurate adsorption equilibrium modeling is critical for bioseparation process design, yet purely data-driven models often violate physical laws.

Result· Stretching-dominated lattices retained higher specific stiffness at low density, and increasing relative density from 0.15 to 0.35 raised linear density-dependent properties by about 2.33 times and quadratic stiffness by about 5.44 times.

Motivation· Singularly perturbed convection-dominated anomalous diffusion problems exhibit sharp boundary layers that degrade the effectiveness of conventional numerical schemes.
Method· A semi-analytical physics-informed neural network framework is developed, in which neural-network corrector functions derived from auxiliary conditions capture thin boundary layers, complemented by Hessian-based convergence and sensitivity analysis.

Validation· Numerical examples on standard benchmark problems demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed framework.

Motivation· This paper aims to systematically compare the influence of planform geometry and aspect ratio on flutter boundaries in rigid and flexible wings, providing a screening tool for preliminary design.

Result· Increasing aspect ratio or reducing stiffness advances flutter for rectangular and trapezoidal wings, while elliptical planforms exhibit flutter resistance under sufficient stiffness, indicating strong coupling between aspect ratio and flexibility.

Outcomes of revision from hip resurfacing to total hip arthroplasty: a matched comparative study with primary total hip arthroplasty at seven and a half years follow-up

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore clinical Exp. validation
Martin Bauters, Mehdi Hormi-Ménard, Philippe-Alexandre Faure, Paul Deschamps, Julien Girard International Orthopaedics 2026-09-03 10.1007/s00264-026-07013-9
单位: Service d’Orthopédie II, Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Lille, Lille, France
通讯: Martin Bauters @ Service d’Orthopédie II, Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Lille, Lille, France
相关性: 该论文为临床随访研究，未涉及生物力学建模或植入物设计，与用户研究方向无关。
边界: This paper is a clinical outcomes study with no biomechanical modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no implant design or patient-specific FE analysis.
动机· 比较髋关节表面置换翻修术与初次全髋关节置换术的临床结果。
方法· 采用匹配对照研究，比较两组患者术后功能与并发症。
结果· 翻修组与初次置换组在随访7.5年时结果相似。
验证· 基于临床随访数据，无生物力学验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare clinical outcomes between revision of hip resurfacing arthroplasty and primary total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A matched comparative study was conducted to evaluate functional and complication outcomes between the two groups.
Result· At a mean follow-up of 7.5 years, revision and primary arthroplasty groups showed comparable outcomes.
Validation· Validation is based on clinical follow-up data without biomechanical testing or computational modeling.

Process-coupled quality regulation of AlSi10Mg heat sinks in laser powder bed fusion using residual-margin surrogate screening

Exclude AM Biomedical Materials openalex Peripheral Ignore none
Haijuan Liu Open Science Framework 2026-09-03 10.17605/osf.io/d2mt8
相关性: 该论文研究铝合金散热器的LPBF工艺质量调控，与生物医学植入物或骨整合无关。
边界: This paper focuses on AlSi10Mg heat sinks for thermal management, with no biomedical context, no porous implant design, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, and no mechanical testing relevant to implants.
动机· 调控LPBF制造散热器的质量，提高工艺稳定性。
方法· 采用残差裕度代理筛选方法，实现过程耦合的质量调控。
结果· 实现了散热器LPBF工艺的质量优化。
验证· 未提供实验验证，可能为数值或理论方法。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enhance the quality control of AlSi10Mg heat sinks fabricated by laser powder bed fusion through process-coupled regulation.
Method· A residual-margin surrogate screening approach is proposed to couple process parameters with quality outcomes.
Result· The method enables effective quality regulation for LPBF-produced heat sinks.
Validation· No experimental validation is reported; the approach appears to be numerical or theoretical.

The approach of orthopaedic and dental physicians to antibiotic prophylaxis for patients who have undergone total knee or total hip arthroplasty: A Questionnaire-Based Study

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none
Kübra Karaçam, Miray Erdem, Rahime Zeynep Erdem BMC Oral Health 2026-09-03 10.1186/s12903-026-09777-3
单位: Department of Periodontology, Faculty of Dentistry, Afyonkarahisar Health Sciences University, Afyonkarahisar, 03030, Turkey
通讯: Kübra Karaçam @ Department of Periodontology, Faculty of Dentistry, Afyonkarahisar Health Sciences University, Afyonkarahisar, 03030, Tu
相关性: 该论文探讨关节置换术后抗生素预防用药的医生态度，与髋关节植入物的生物力学或有限元分析无关。
边界: This paper does not involve any biomechanical modeling, stress shielding, micromotion, or implant design; it is a clinical survey on antibiotic prophylaxis practices.
动机· 探讨牙医与骨科医生对关节置换术后抗生素预防用药的态度差异。
方法· 通过在线问卷收集460名医生（牙医与骨科医生）的用药倾向，并进行统计分析。
结果· 骨科医生比牙医更倾向于使用抗生素预防，部分问题存在显著差异。
验证· 采用描述性统计和卡方检验分析问卷数据。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To assess the attitudes of dental and orthopedic practitioners regarding antibiotic prophylaxis for patients with joint arthroplasty, given the lack of strong evidence.
Method· An online 15-item questionnaire was distributed to dentists and orthopedic surgeons, and responses were analyzed using descriptive statistics and Pearson Chi-square tests.
Result· Orthopedic surgeons were more inclined to prescribe antibiotic prophylaxis than dentists, with significant differences on six items.
Validation· Statistical analysis of survey responses from 460 practitioners.
